plan.title: Counter offer with no changed values

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ response view containing the vendor's normal bid.
Open the counter-offer drawer for the vendor's own bid.
Select the line item without changing its quoted value.
Attempt to send the unchanged counter offer.
